issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the method: problem statement text refers to get_total_number_of_students(), while the UML and the Java code use getTotalNumberOfStudents(). Problem statement (text) uses snake_case: `get_total_number_of_students()`; UML in problem_statement.md lists `getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int`; template Lecture.java TODO refers to getTotalNumberOfStudents in the task comment; solution Lecture.java implements `public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This mismatch can confuse students about the exact method name to implement and may cause failures in automated checks that expect the camelCase name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Update the problem_statement.md text (line 41) to use the camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` and, if helpful, show the exact signature `public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. Ensure any task descriptions, UML entries, template TODOs, and tests consistently reference `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` so students and automated checks use the same identifier.

issues.description: The concept is the method that returns the total number of students in a Lecture. In problem_statement.md (line 40) this method is named using snake_case: get_total_number_of_students(). In the UML in the problem statement (line 70), in the template Lecture.java (line 12 TODO comment) and in the solution Lecture.java (method declaration at line 75) the method is named using camelCase: getTotalNumberOfStudents(). A student reading the textual task might implement get_total_number_of_students() (matching the wording) while the provided code, UML and solution expect getTotalNumberOfStudents(), causing a naming mismatch and extra confusion when mapping the requirement to the template code or automated checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md to use the camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents() (replace get_total_number_of_students()) so it matches the UML, the template TODO, and the solution implementation.
